messages.author: d4ab5ca90dc597f9
messages.subject: Stumped with Maaslin2
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying out Maaslin2 on one of my datasets and I get an error after running the Maaslin2 command:

mh_user@MicrobiomeHelper:~/Desktop/maaslin2$ ./maaslin2/R/Maaslin2.R features.txt metadata.txt ./output
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Writing function arguments to log file
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Verifying options selected are valid
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Determining format of input files
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Input format is data samples as rows and metadata samples as rows
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Formula for fixed effects: expr ~  Depression + SSRI + Pup_treatment + Sex
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Filter data based on min abundance and min prevalence
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Total samples in data: 155
2018-11-16 02:57:04 INFO::Min samples required with min abundance for a feature not to be filtered: 15.500000
Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , colSums(data >= min_abundance) > min_samples) : 
  undefined columns selected
Calls: Maaslin2 -> [ -> [.data.frame
Execution halted

I get this same error whether I use Maaslin2 at the command line or in R. When I inspect the the data + metadata data.frames they look fine.

Any help would be great!

Thanks,
Peter

messages.author: d4ab5ca90dc597f9
messages.subject: Re: Stumped with Maaslin2
parts:
The problem was caused by a single blank cell in the data table. Entering "0" allowed the command to work properly. 

The code has since been updated to fix this automatically.
